content.text:
Action: Search local persona data for Greenwich and Dinoco confirmation details.  
<tool_call>
<function=bash>
<parameter=command>grep -RInE "Greenwich|Dinoco|NYC|New York|check-in|confirmation" /home/user/Documents /home/user/Downloads /home/user/Maildir 2>/dev/null | head -200</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

Action: Wait for the search results to appear.  
<tool_call>
<function=computer_use>
<parameter=action>wait</parameter>
<parameter=time>1</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

Action: Search all likely app and mail storage for matching travel confirmations.  
<tool_call>
<function=bash>
<parameter=command>grep -RInE "Greenwich|Dinoco|NYC|New York|confirmation|check.?in" /home/user 2>/dev/null | head -300</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

Action: Open Dinoco Airlines from the bookmarks bar to access flight booking information.  
<tool_call>
<function=computer_use>
<parameter=action>left_click</parameter>
<parameter=coordinate>1130,132</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

Action: Check whether the Dinoco page opened.  
<tool_call>
<function=computer_use>
<parameter=action>wait</parameter>
<parameter=time>2</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

Action: Click the Dinoco Airlines bookmark to open the flight booking app.  
<tool_call>
<function=computer_use>
<parameter=action>left_click</parameter>
<parameter=coordinate>1130,132</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

Action: Read the NYC trip note plus the matching hotel and Dinoco email confirmations.  
<tool_call>
<function=bash>
<parameter=command>cat /home/user/Documents/Trips/new_york_city.txt && printf '\n--- FLIGHT EMAIL ---\n' && cat /home/user/Maildir/.Travel/cur/1787288412.0000.0e84caea5b30e2a8.mail && printf '\n--- HOTEL EMAIL ---\n' && cat /home/user/Maildir/.Travel/cur/1787288412.0003.0f21e6db55a24fb0.mail</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

Action: Report the requested NYC trip details: hotel confirmation GH-29481, flight confirmation DN-87856, and check-in date 2026-05-05.  
<tool_call>
<function=computer_use>
<parameter=action>terminate</parameter>
<parameter=status>success</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
